integrity_notes: All exact formulas have an unrestricted algebraic derivation and a finite independent rational-Laplacian checker; no external independent mathematical audit. limitations: Real unweighted graphs K_(m,n) with an internal matching in one vertex class, m>=4,n>=2; canonical Euclidean-orthogonal projections only; not arbitrary projection minima, weighted graphs, or intermediate ell_p operator norms.
title: Exact endpoint Hodge norms and a matching-saturation transition in complete bipartite graphs
